Metronome Tool

A precise metronome with WebAudio clicks — set any BPM, beats per bar and subdivision, with tap tempo and a visual pulse.

120
BPM

📖 How to use

  1. Set the BPM with the slider or tap tempo.
  2. Choose beats per bar and note subdivision.
  3. Press Start — follow the clicks and the flashing beat dot.
  4. Press Stop when done.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How accurate is the timing?

Timing uses the Web Audio clock (lookahead scheduling), which is far more accurate than setInterval.

Does it have tap tempo?

Yes — tap the Tap button at least 3 times and the BPM is set from your taps.

Is the first beat accented?

Beat 1 gets a higher accent click; you can set 0–12 beats per bar.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes — works on desktop and mobile browsers.
